population.semantics: Frozen Natural UGR v2 Stage-2 upward proposal population

target_rule.candidate_set: all numerals n such that n > baseline_prediction
target_rule.selection: candidate with maximum frozen baseline numeral probability
target_rule.tie_break: smallest candidate numeral among equal-probability maxima

evaluation_rule.ground_truth_role: evaluation only; never used for target construction
evaluation_rule.primary_future_endpoint: end-to-end counting accuracy versus frozen baseline
